easy.def: A group of things tied together.
examples: Dad had a bundle of sticks.
Mom gave me a bundle of clean socks.
The baby is in a bundle of blankets.

more.def: A number of things tied or wrapped together.
examples: She carried a bundle of newspapers under her arm.
He tied the old letters in a bundle with string.
The farmer stacked bundles of hay in the barn.

easy.def: A hole in the ground where an animal lives.
examples: The rabbit ran into its burrow.
A mole lives in a burrow.
The snake hid in a burrow.

more.def: A hole or tunnel that an animal digs in the ground to live in.
examples: The fox kept her cubs safe in a burrow under the hill.
Prairie dogs dig burrows with many rooms.
The owl made its nest in an empty burrow.
